title: Asymptotic Theory for Restricted Maximum Likelihood Estimators in Generalized Linear Mixed Models
summary: Developing an asymptotic theory for restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimators in generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) has remained an open problem for decades. In this paper, we establish the asymptotic distributions of the REML and maximum likelihood (ML) estimators for GLMMs when both the number of clusters and the cluster sizes tend to infinity.
